sam: Opened PR with a short Private/VPC install appendix: minimal firewall, offline-bundle checksum, and an nftables example. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5102

ivy: quick scan 4: recommend calling out that some HSMs need 5698/tcp and optionally 5699/tcp for admin. mark 5699 as optional.

kevin: agree. also add an SELinux extract note (`restorecon -R /opt/offline-bundles`) and a path-length example (`/opt/offline/redwood-2026-04.tar.gz`) for older filesystems.

sam: added both and changed wording to "allowlist" for network rules. also included a tiny conn-checker: `curl -sSf http://localhost:8080/health` and a 3-line openssl check for registry certs.

ci-bot: Lint: OK. Broken links: 0. CI: queued.

ivy: small security nit: avoid "allow all egress" language; recommend explicit domains (e.g., `rdw-inference-updates.redwood.ai:443`) and note retry-on-fail for downloads (up to 3 attempts).

sam: updated wording and retry guidance. planning to merge after CI green. filing follow-up to add annotated conn-checker screenshots (issue #5103).
